standard_prerequisites.name: Right acyclicity for a left exact functor
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter together with the general theory of derived functors: a sheaf is right acyclic for a left exact functor when the higher derived functors vanish on it
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the property verified for the four functors listed.

core_obligations: First two functors (proof lines 2287-2295): total acyclicity is exactly the vanishing needed for the functors H^0(U, -) and F -> F(K) on the objects of the site and on presheaves of sets, by the criterion of the section.

Global sections and pushforward (proof lines 2295-2302): the global sections functor and the pushforward along a morphism of ringed topoi are treated by the same criterion, since total acyclicity is stable under the passage to these functors.
proof_roadmap: Read right acyclicity for the section functors off total acyclicity by the criterion of the section.
Treat global sections and pushforward by the same argument.
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that a totally acyclic sheaf is right acyclic for four functors: the section functor at an object, evaluation on a presheaf of sets, global sections, and pushforward along a morphism of ringed topoi (statement lines 2272-2285). The proof applies the criterion of the section characterizing total acyclicity to each of the four functors (proof lines 2287-2302), the last two being handled by the same computation. The non-formal content is the reading of the criterion in the four cases. The claim is H2: four applications of one criterion.
